title: Finite intrinsic projection open factor
statement: Fix D,C,E,m,S,f,c,K,L,U,V,k,l as in [def-sf-finite-intrinsic-projection-coordinates], with the specified canonical comparison [def-sf-canonical-finite-intrinsic-tensor-comparison]. The open and pullback-compositor tail satisfies midpoint followed by fixedTail and targetComparison.inv equals the intrinsic open/compositor word followed by the canonical target-coordinate maps. This compares only the open tensor map and inverse-image compositor; no proper projection mate occurs.

proof.text: transpose the intrinsic inverse open tensor map through the actual open extension/restriction adjunction. Its transpose is the open unit tensored with identity followed by inverse tensor/pullback comparison. The coefficient realization preserves that unit: it is identity on sections over the open, and the unique map from zero elsewhere. On simultaneous flat K-flat representatives the scalar tensor square with open restriction sends each pure tensor to the same two sections. Localization descends this equality, and injectivity of the open adjunction identifies the inverse open tensor maps. The fixed open tensor map is an isomorphism, so transport through the coefficient and tensor isomorphisms makes the intrinsic inverse open tensor map invertible too. Thus inverseOnDomain is its actual inverse, and the equality also identifies the forward open maps. For the remaining pullback compositor, the two section-normalized comparisons are equal on every section by the inverse-image unit uniqueness property. Their derived comparisons agree by the localization universal property, including the equality cast from c.comm. Tensor naturality pastes this compositor square onto the open square. Apply proper direct image and its realization comparison. Expand targetComparison and fixedPullRealization: the coefficient units cancel by the triangle identities; finitePullback and finiteSupport are precisely the remaining displayed target factors. This yields the displayed equation, without any proper projection or its invertibility. The argument applies to zero inputs, identity opens, empty opens and m=0.

theorem finiteIntrinsicProjectionOpenFactor
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (m : ℕ)
    (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m))
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) X)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) Y.obj.left)
    (U : normalizedDVRDerived C.l E X.obj.left m)
    (V : normalizedDVRDerived C.l E Y.obj.left m) (k : U ≅ K.obj) (l : V ≅ L.obj) :
    midpoint m f c K L U V k l ≫ fixedTail m f c K L ≫
        (targetComparison S f c K L).inv =
      ((proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage c.g
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E (m + 1))).map
          (SystemProjectionFormula.inverseOnDomain
            (SystemProjectionFormula.finiteOpenTensorInv C.l E D C.different c.i
              X.obj.hom (c.g ≫ Y.obj.hom) m U
              ((finiteDerivedPullback C.l E m c.g).obj V))) ≫
        (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E (m + 1)) c).map
          ((finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor C.l E X.obj.left m).map
            (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 U)
              (((SystemProjectionFormula.finitePullComp C.l E c.i c.g m).symm ≪≫
                eqToIso (congrArg (finiteDerivedPullback C.l E m) c.comm.symm)).hom.app V)))) ≫
      ((sixFunctorFiniteSupport D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) f c).map
        ((canonicalFiniteIntrinsicTensorComparison (C := C) (E := E) m X).hom.app
          (U, (finiteDerivedPullback C.l E m f.hom.left).obj V) ≫
          (evaluatedTensor (C := C) (E := E) m X).map
            (Prod.mkHom k.hom ((finiteDerivedPullback C.l E m f.hom.left).map l.hom ≫
              (S.finitePullback f).inv.app ⟨L.obj, L.property.1⟩))) ≫
        (S.finiteSupport f c).inv.app
          (((partialTensor S X).obj K).obj ((torPull S f).obj L)))
